documentationFacts.section: AGENTS Running/debugging; DESIGN debug options; OPTICS diagnostic introduction
documentationFacts.fact: Configuration and diagnostics are read from the fragment after #. Append &debugMotion=1 or &motion=full to that same fragment. A query-only ?debugMotion=1 is not read. The six debugOptic force names are halo, sundogs, pillar, anticrep, paraselene and lunarhalo. Corona, earthshine, refraction and the crepuscular ray require controlled physical scene inputs; no dedicated debugOptic switch forces them.

reuseRules: Reuse an accepted row only with unchanged relevant source bytes, interface, test inputs and native environment assumptions; bind them in a reuse manifest. A new source/tree digest alone is insufficient. Changing README does not invalidate unchanged native installer bytes.

The current 16-case public rollout and 139-file binding establish the delivered baseline. They do not establish future changed documentation, diagnostic-specific overlay/reduced-motion cases, or every backlog obligation.

If an installer/runtime/serializer changes, invalidate the affected call-chain and mutant receipts and rerun only the corresponding necessary native/consumer gates after authorization. A doc-only patch reuses unchanged parser/selector/staging/currentness interfaces.

conditions: After independent review and future execution authorization, use a focused non-closing PR (Implements #N). No commit/push/merge/deployment/publication authority is supplied by this planning packet.

After separately authorized integration and delivery, record final commit/tree, authored/generated file hashes, exact inspected commands, environment, per-case results, controls, failed attempts and residual limits. Compare the advertised raw scripts and generated builder command with the final reviewed bytes; acquire changed public docs and inspect their rendered consumers where required.

Closure certificate names every original residual parent ID, its child acceptance records, unchanged accepted-row evidence, independent reviewer and actual delivery readbacks. Keep the issue open if a required platform, discriminator, document or consumer proof is missing. Primary issue-closure authority acts only after this certificate; no automatic close via PR keywords.
Every original residual/child and unchanged accepted-row binding is qualified; cold review admitted; missing native/consumer/document cell leaves issue open.

Delivery mode is docs-merge for current docs/fixture/evidence residuals. No runtime rewrite is mandatory. A genuine native product counterexample must be preserved and receive a narrowly authorized repair/revised scope before code changes.
closure.authority: Primary explicit closure only after future executor/effect authorization and actual required proof/delivery; no closure/publication/execution authority in this spec
